notes.title: Directors Cut Patch Now Available
notes.notes:
Updated Build

Directors Cut Now Available. 

Adds some features Like Easy Mode and fixes some previous bugs and glitches.

notes.title: Cartridge Patch
notes.notes:
This Patch matches the Digital version of the game to the NES cartridge release.

Adds the ability to obtain infinite lives in stage 1.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: Added End scene dialogue with NPC

notes.title: Quality Patch
notes.notes:
Added Title Music.
Added Ending Cut scene  and music.
Added ability to start with Infinite lives after beating any mode.

notes.title: Major Patch Ver 2.0
notes.notes:
Desert Of The Undead 2.0 patch fixes the following:
Fixes: Final boss crash that would happen if you hugged the right side of the screen.
Fixes: Slowdown in mayors mansion that would cause enemies to disappear. This would cause death as players couldn't see them
Fixes: Bug in third to last boss that could occasionally cause the boss to fall through the floor causing a hard lock
Fixes: Warp door in stage 1 now optional (previous version this door was not optional)
Fixes: Warp door in mayors mansion that would sometimes send player back to stage 1
Fixes: Stage 1 boss would occasionally get stuck and disappear from screen causing hard lock 

Desert Of The Undead 2.0 additions
Added Checkpoint in stage 1
Stage 2 boss visual improvements and more challenging
Stage 2 hidden warp door (allows players to skip most of stage 2)
Stage 3 hidden warp door (hidden warp door in stage 3 will take you to end game boss)
Stage 2 first boss only will spawn 2 worms at a time to limit slowdown

notes.title: Infamous Seem Glitch FIXED!!!
notes.notes: A Glitch in NES maker was causing a line to appear when warping into non scrolling screens. This bug caused a line of the previous screens  palettes to load in a vertical line in the middle of the screen.

notes.title: Warp Patch
notes.notes: Fixed warp after 2nd level boss. Player warped Straight to City Outskirts and skipped cut-scene

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes: Patched a typo in the beginning of the game.
